content: Size of a length field for a chosen fixed-size array The at- tribute sizeOfArrayLengthField of SOMEIPTransformationProps defines the size of a length field generated by the SOME/IP transformer in front of the fixed-size array for which the DataPrototypeTransformationProps is defined according to [TPS_SYST_02121].

Size of a length field for a chosen array The attribute size- OfArrayLengthField of SOMEIPTransformationProps defines the size of a length field generated by the SOME/IP transformer in front of the fixed-size or dy- namic size array for which the DataPrototypeTransformationProps is defined according to [TPS_SYST_02121].
